dataset: Survey of India Administrative Boundary Data Base (ABDB)
authority: Survey of India, Government of India
notes: ABDB is an authoritative administrative/geospatial boundary source, not a parcel-title or ownership database.
The State/District/Sub-District PAN-India archive is linked directly from the official ABDB page.
The Village Boundary page currently lists downloadable vector data by State/UT; the page should be used as the authoritative index rather than hard-coding an assumed 36-file list.
Do not use ABDB alone to infer legal ownership or title.
